messages:
Tara (Customer Success): FYI invoice 5344 for Velora Labs failed during our nightly card sweep. Stripe returned decline `insufficient_funds`. They're on a deployment call and want to get access today. Can we do a manual retry or accept wire/ACH? @Owen (Finance) advice? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

billing-bot: [payment.failed] invoice=5344 customer=VeloraLabs provider=Stripe code=insufficient_funds id=pi_9Zx... log="card_decline_insufficient_funds"

Owen (Finance): We can attempt one manual retry now but note gateway may decline again if the card truly lacks funds. Recommend offering wire (Fedwire/SWIFT) for same-day clearing or Plaid ACH for next-day. If they insist on ACH but their bank blocks micro-deposits, we accept: a bank letter on letterhead, a bank-stamped screenshot, or outbound wire confirmation.

Ravi (Ops): Operational note: wait 10-15m from the failed auth before retrying to avoid duplicate auth conflicts. I can queue a manual retry for +15m if you want me to. Also, if you give me the go-ahead to release environment on proof of wire, I'll coordinate infra.

Carmen (Sales): We'll hold activation until payment clears or we receive the bank confirmation. If they wire today, we can expedite provisioning and credit them one week of service as a courtesy.

Tara (Customer Success): Billing contact is ap@velora.io. They tried using a corporate virtual card and got the decline; they said their AP team prefers Fedwire for large transfers. Asked them to confirm if they can do same-day Fedwire.

Owen (Finance): Send wire template over secure channel only. For Fedwire use routing below; for international use SWIFT. Also request their tax/PO number for matching.

Owen (Finance): Wire instructions (secure):

Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Bank (Fedwire): First National Bank of Redwood
Fedwire Routing: 026009593
Account #: 987654321
SWIFT/BIC: FNBUS33
Reference: INVOICE 5344 / Velora Labs
Please include payer company name and PO/TAX ID in the payment reference and forward the bank's outbound confirmation (PDF or SWIFT copy).

Owen (Finance): Process: once we receive the outbound confirmation showing amount, timestamp, sender, and routing, finance will record a "paid pending settlement" entry in QuickBooks and suppress automatic dunning emails. If they provide a bank letter instead of a wire, we require it on official letterhead and dated within 30 days.

Tara (Customer Success): Sent secure Fedwire template to ap@velora.io and asked them to reply here with the confirmation scan. They replied: "We will initiate Fedwire now and share the confirmation." I'll post the redacted confirmation once it arrives.

Ravi (Ops): Copy. Once Owen marks paid pending, I'll flip the provisioning hold and ping infra.

Owen (Finance): Thanks. If they later dispute the payment or the wire bounces, we'll revert and notify the CS/Sales leads. For now I'll add an AR note to suppress reminders for invoice 5344.

Carmen (Sales): Great work team. Tara, please paste the confirmation here when you get it and tag Ops. :white_check_mark:
